title: 卡沙甘人工島開發
summary: 卡沙甘位於淺水北裏海並以人工島開發；本課以淺海地基、物流與地面處理界面做假想分析。本課依序分析人工島平均承載、島體差異沉降、淺海物流庫存緩衝、含硫介面檢驗證據、季節性補給等待，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Kashagan lies in the shallow North Caspian and uses artificial islands; teaching examines foundations, logistics and processing interfaces. The course analyses average bearing load on an artificial island, differential island settlement, inventory buffer for shallow-water logistics, inspection evidence for sour-service interfaces, seasonal supply waiting, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 人工島平均承載、島體差異沉降、淺海物流庫存緩衝
v31FocusEn: Average bearing load on an artificial island; Differential island settlement; Inventory buffer for shallow-water logistics

quiz.question: 關於「人工島平均承載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Average bearing load on an artificial island" is correct?
options: 平均支承壓力由有效垂直力除以承載面積得到，可作為基礎荷載帳的第一步。
平均壓力低就代表平台基礎的所有極限狀態都合格。
整個平台下沉一樣多，就等於所有接口沒有位移問題。
optionsEn: Average support pressure is effective vertical load divided by bearing area, a first step in the foundation load account.
Low average pressure proves every foundation limit state passes.
Equal overall platform subsidence means every interface is free of displacement problems.
quiz.explanation: 平均支承壓力由有效垂直力除以承載面積得到，可作為基礎荷載帳的第一步。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Average support pressure is effective vertical load divided by bearing area, a first step in the foundation load account. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Average bearing load on an artificial island” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Kashagan island development”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「人工島平均承載」。卡沙甘位於淺水北裏海並以人工島開發；本課以淺海地基、物流與地面處理界面做假想分析。在「卡沙甘人工島開發」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。平均支承壓力由有效垂直力除以承載面積得到，可作為基礎荷載帳的第一步。重力式結構還受到浮力、偏心、波浪及地基非線性影響；平均壓力不等於局部接觸壓力，也不能單獨判定抗滑與抗傾覆。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Average bearing load on an artificial island”. Kashagan lies in the shallow North Caspian and uses artificial islands; teaching examines foundations, logistics and processing interfaces. In the teaching model for Kashagan island development, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Average support pressure is effective vertical load divided by bearing area, a first step in the foundation load account. Gravity structures also experience buoyancy, eccentricity, waves and nonlinear soil response. Average pressure differs from local contact stress and cannot by itself establish sliding or overturning adequacy. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 人工島平均承載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Average bearing load on an artificial island: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「人工島平均承載」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Average bearing load on an artificial island” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p = M g/A；代入 M = 110250 tonne effective supported mass、A = 16000 m²，得 67.6 kPa（「人工島平均承載」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 M 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: p = M g/A; with M = 110250 tonne effective supported mass, A = 16000 m² the result is 67.6 kPa (simplified exercise for Average bearing load on an artificial island; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise M by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：M 增加 10% 時，結果變為 74.4 kPa（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising M by 10% changes the result to 74.4 kPa (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 67.6 kPa（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 M 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 67.6 kPa (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in M with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Average bearing load on an artificial island: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「人工島平均承載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Average bearing load on an artificial island” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「人工島平均承載」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。在自由體圖逐項列出重量與浮力，再以兩個不同面積的假想基礎比較平均壓力；確認單位為力除面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Average bearing load on an artificial island”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. List weight and buoyancy in a free-body diagram and compare average pressure for two hypothetical foundation areas, explicitly checking force-per-area units. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 040-01 標記，圖表須寫明「卡沙甘人工島開發：教學假設」。提交自由體圖與平均值，明確列出偏心、動載及土壤性質未被本模型解決。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 040-01 and mark charts “Kashagan island development: teaching assumptions”. Submit the free-body diagram and average value, explicitly listing eccentricity, dynamic loads and soil response as unresolved by this model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「人工島平均承載」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Average bearing load on an artificial island” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
整個平台下沉一樣多，就等於所有接口沒有位移問題。

Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.

steps.title: 人工島平均承載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Average bearing load on an artificial island: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「人工島平均承載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Average bearing load on an artificial island” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「人工島平均承載」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。若漏列浮力或把質量直接當力，結果會偏離；局部支承不均與底面空隙可能使平均值正常而局部應力過高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「卡沙甘人工島開發」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Average bearing load on an artificial island” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Omitting buoyancy or treating mass as force biases the result; uneven support and seabed gaps can produce high local stress despite an acceptable-looking average. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Kashagan island development”.
